subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-09-04
html:
Weekly Pulse — Sept 4, 2026

~9 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Shipped since last pulse (2026-08-28): an on-page retarget of /connect/search-console-mcp for the emerged term "google search console mcp" (390/mo, up from 0 four months ago) on 2026-08-31; the Month 2 review on 2026-09-01, scored Missed (0 of 4 KPIs), which set Month 3 goals; and a schema-parity fix on /services/seo-specialist (WebPage/breadcrumb/FAQPage + dateModified across all 6 persona pages) on 2026-09-03. The headline this week is a blocker, not a metric: the SE Ranking connector needed a human OAuth re-authorization last session and still needs one today — no live keyword pull was possible, so ranking movement and traffic below are reported from the last successful pull (2026-09-01) rather than fresh data.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending — GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing, but this sandbox still has no outbound GA4 API access. Waiting on the scheduled data Action (12-week-strategy.md Week 8) to backfill this row.

Ranking movement

Pending — SE Ranking MCP connector is unauthenticated this session (same as 2026-09-03, now 2 consecutive sessions). The tool schema itself is gated behind an OAuth step this sandbox cannot run; a human needs to re-authorize the connector before any fresh pull is possible. Table below shows the last live figures, pulled 2026-09-01 (Month 2 review), not a fresh check — treat "now" as stale by 3 days, not current.

As of the 2026-09-01 pull: 0 of 22 tracked keywords held a measurable position (all outside the top 100), domain_trust had ticked 4→5, and index_google: "1" confirmed Google is indexing the domain. No day since then has been checked. This is the first weekly pulse in the routine's history unable to run its own daily-check loop — a data gap, not a new "flat" data point.

Traffic vs last week

Pending / unreachable this session for the same reason as above — getDomainOverviewByCountry and getBacklinksSummary both need the SE Ranking connector. Last known (2026-09-01): 0 indexed organic keywords; backlinks still 2 / 1 referring domain (futurlabs.dev), unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01.

Anything broken?

SE Ranking MCP connector needs a human re-authorization — unauthenticated for 2 consecutive sessions now (2026-09-03, 2026-09-04). This blocks both live-pull-driven content decisions and this pulse's own rank-check data. This is the single most actionable item in this report.

Checked GitHub Actions directly this session (not just assumed green): the SEO Report Email workflow fired twice for the 2026-09-03 push (runs #31 and #32, identical commit) — both "Send queued reports" steps completed successfully, so that report likely emailed twice; run #32's archive-commit step then failed on a git-push race (run #31 had already pushed the archive commit first) — no data was lost, reports/sent/2026-09-03-services-schema-fix.json archived correctly, but the report recipient may have gotten a duplicate email. All-time: 30 of 32 SEO Report Email runs green (the original 2026-07-04 shakeout failure + this new duplicate-run failure). Keepalive: 4 of 4 green. No code was shipped this session (pure reporting), so no build-gate was needed.

catalog.ts re-checked, unchanged since 2026-08-31: meta_ads/linkedin_ads/meta_pages (May 2026 eta) 4+ months overdue, tiktok_ads/stripe (June 2026) 3+ months overdue, hubspot/mailerlite (July 2026) 2+ months overdue, mailchimp (August 2026) now past its own ETA month, shopify (April 2026) remains the single most-overdue entry at 5+ months. Off-page Phase 1 still 0 of 6 (needs a human with a browser). GSC sitemap submission still open since kickoff. The dormant 6-persona route.ts scaffold and the ChatGPT-assistant-column connector variant both remain open human-decision items.

Reading the week

Content and correctness work kept its pace — an on-page retarget, a full monthly review, and a real schema bug fixed — but this week's honest headline is that the routine's own instrumentation broke: for the first time since tracking began, this pulse could not check a single day of live rank data, because the SE Ranking connector needs a human to click through an OAuth prompt this sandbox cannot reach. That's a small, fast fix for a person with a browser, and it's now blocking two things at once — fresh content targeting decisions and this report's core numbers. Paired with the standing blockers (off-page at 0/6, five overdue catalog.ts connectors, GSC submission), the pattern is the same one flagged in the last two pulses: on-page work is caught up and disciplined, but every lever that would actually move the needle right now needs a few minutes of human time, not another session of code.
